description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for notes in a Room database, providing CRUD operations such as observation, retrieval by ID, insertion, updating, and deletion of notes.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: Interface for accessing notes in the database, providing methods for CRUD operations with Room annotations.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all notes ordered by latest update timestamp.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspended function to retrieve a note by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Suspended function to insert a new note, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Suspended function to update an existing note.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Function to delete a specified note.
